import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] data;
        int size;

        Matrix(int size) {
            this.size = size;
            data = new int[size + 1][size + 1];
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            Matrix result = new Matrix(this.size);
            for (int i = 0; i <= this.size; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= this.size; ++j) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= this.size; ++k) {
                        sum += (long) this.data[i][k] * other.data[k][j];
                    }
                    result.data[i][j] = (int) (sum % MOD);
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N = sc.nextLong();
        long K = sc.nextLong();

        int[] digits = new int[70];
        int count = 0;
        while (N != 0) {
            digits[count++] = (int) (N % K);
            N /= K;
        }

        // Initialize matrices
        Matrix[][] baseMatrices = new Matrix[64][30];
        Matrix[][] prefixMatrices = new Matrix[64][30];
        Matrix[][] suffixMatrices = new Matrix[64][30];

        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j) {
                baseMatrices[0][i] = new Matrix((int) K);
                baseMatrices[0][i].data[j][j] = 1;
                baseMatrices[0][i].data[j][(int) i] = 1;
            }
            baseMatrices[0][(int) i].size = (int) K;
        }

        // Initialize prefix and suffix matrices
        prefixMatrices[0][0] = cloneMatrix(baseMatrices[0][0]);
        suffixMatrices[0][(int) K - 1] = cloneMatrix(baseMatrices[0][(int) K - 1]);

        for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
            prefixMatrices[0][i] = prefixMatrices[0][i - 1].multiply(baseMatrices[0][i]);
        }

        for (int i = (int) K - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
            suffixMatrices[0][i] = baseMatrices[0][i].multiply(suffixMatrices[0][i + 1]);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < count; ++i) {
            baseMatrices[i][0] = cloneMatrix(suffixMatrices[i - 1][0]);
            for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j) {
                baseMatrices[i][j] = suffixMatrices[i - 1][j].multiply(prefixMatrices[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }

            prefixMatrices[i][0] = cloneMatrix(baseMatrices[i][0]);
            suffixMatrices[i][(int) K - 1] = cloneMatrix(baseMatrices[i][(int) K - 1]);

            for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j) {
                prefixMatrices[i][j] = prefixMatrices[i][j - 1].multiply(baseMatrices[i][j]);
            }

            for (int j = (int) K - 2; j >= 0; --j) {
                suffixMatrices[i][j] = baseMatrices[i][j].multiply(suffixMatrices[i][j + 1]);
            }
        }

        // Initialize final answer matrix
        Matrix finalAnswer = new Matrix((int) K);
        finalAnswer.data[0][(int) K] = 1;
        finalAnswer.size = (int) K;

        finalAnswer = finalAnswer.multiply(prefixMatrices[count - 1][digits[count - 1] - 1]);

        int lastDigit = digits[count - 1];
        for (int i = count - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < digits[i]; ++j) {
                finalAnswer = finalAnswer.multiply(baseMatrices[i][(j + lastDigit) % K]);
            }
            lastDigit += digits[i];
        }

        long totalSum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= (int) K; ++i) {
            totalSum += finalAnswer.data[0][i];
        }

        System.out.println(totalSum % MOD);
        sc.close();
    }

    static Matrix cloneMatrix(Matrix m) {
        Matrix clone = new Matrix(m.size);
        for (int i = 0; i <= m.size; ++i) {
            System.arraycopy(m.data[i], 0, clone.data[i], 0, m.size + 1);
        }
        return clone;
    }
